narration:0:1611104001:0.text: Meanwhile, in the woods by Starfall Lake...
narration:0:1611104001:0.source_cn: 与此同时，坠星湖畔的树林中……

say:4:1611104002:0.text: Relax. I'll tear open a spatial rift and send you straight to the upper levels of that tower.
say:4:1611104002:0.source_cn: 不用紧张，我会用法术撕裂空间，直接将你送到那座魔法塔的上层。

say:5:1611104003:0.text: This spot should work.. It's the perfect distance. Heh, quite the hidden fortress, isn't it...
say:5:1611104003:0.source_cn: 就在这里吧，这个距离正合适。呵，真是足够隐秘的魔法塔啊……

say:6:1611104004:0.text: Magister Cyran, you aren't coming with me? With you there, we'd surely secure the Memory Star.
say:6:1611104004:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷大人，您不一起去吗？如果您在场，我们一定能顺利...

say:7:1611104005:0.text: Ah, how I'd love to visit my old friend again. So many interesting memories... Pity, really.
say:7:1611104005:0.source_cn: 我倒是很想再去我的老朋友家里做客，看看故人的居所总是会...
say:7:1611104005:0.male: Ah, how I'd love to visit my old friend again. So many interesting memories... Pity, really.
say:7:1611104005:0.female: Ah, how I'd love to visit my old friend again. So many interesting memories... Pity, really.

say:8:1611104006:0.text: That fool Leymar was too stubborn. He insisted the tower opens only to those who reach the finals.
say:8:1611104006:0.source_cn: 雷蒙那个蠢货太固执了，只同意给进入决赛的学生开启进入魔...

say:9:1611104007:0.text: I employed every ounce of persuasion, yet he wouldn't yield. He even bound himself from entering. On this single matter, he was as obstinate as a plow mule—nowhere near as clever as he fancies himself to be.
say:9:1611104007:0.source_cn: 无论我如何劝说，他都不松口，甚至连他自己都不能进入。在...

say:11:1611104008:0.text: Ah, but that reminds me... here. The Umbral Gem. Consider it a small <style="highlight">gift</style> for my long-lost friend. When the time comes, deliver it to <style="highlight">Merlin</style>.
say:11:1611104008:0.source_cn: 啊，我差点忘了……这颗邃黯宝石——我送给阔别已久的老朋...
say:11:1611104008:0.male: Ah, but that reminds me... here. The Umbral Gem. Consider it a small <style="highlight">gift</style> for my long-lost friend. When the time comes, deliver it to <style="highlight">Merlin</style>.
say:11:1611104008:0.female: Ah, but that reminds me... here. The Umbral Gem. Consider it a small <style="highlight">gift</style> for my long-lost friend. When the time comes, deliver it to <style="highlight">Merlin</style>.

say:14:1611104010:0.text: Why, what's with that look? Don't tell me you're frightened.

say:15:1611104011:0.text: He's a tougher opponent than Cassadee ever was. A real challenge.
say:15:1611104011:0.male: He's a tougher opponent than Cassadee ever was. A real challenge.
say:15:1611104011:0.female: She's a tougher opponent than Cassadee ever was. A real challenge.

say:16:1611104012:0.text: That's exactly why I admire him... and why I have to surpass him!
say:16:1611104012:0.male: That's exactly why I admire him... and why I have to surpass him!
say:16:1611104012:0.female: That's exactly why I admire her... and why I have to surpass her!

say:17:1611104013:0.text: Heh... how nostalgic. You almost remind me of my younger self.
say:17:1611104013:0.source_cn: ……多么相似啊，你让我看到些许自己过去的影子。

say:18:1611104014:0.text: Now, take this gem. I've invested such a considerable amount of time preparing it—all to ensure my old friend receives a proper... surprise.
say:18:1611104014:0.source_cn: 拿着这颗宝石，我花费了如此漫长的时间准备，就是为了给我...
say:18:1611104014:0.male: Now, take this gem. I've invested such a considerable amount of time preparing it—all to ensure my old friend receives a proper... surprise.
say:18:1611104014:0.female: Now, take this gem. I've invested such a considerable amount of time preparing it—all to ensure my old friend receives a proper... surprise.

say:19:1611104015:0.text: Crush it, and the echo sealed within will <style="highlight">bind Merlin</style> in place.
say:19:1611104015:0.source_cn: 捏碎它，里面蕴含着的来自深渊的美妙回响可以<style...
say:19:1611104015:0.male: Crush it, and the echo sealed within will <style="highlight">bind Merlin</style> in place.
say:19:1611104015:0.female: Crush it, and the echo sealed within will <style="highlight">bind Merlin</style> in place.

say:20:1611104016:0.text: It truly is a shame I won't be present to witness the moment myself, but I trust you'll make it memorable. Don't disappoint me.
say:20:1611104016:0.source_cn: 呵呵……真可惜，我没法亲眼看到那一幕。这份贵重的礼物就...
say:20:1611104016:0.male: It truly is a shame I won't be present to witness the moment myself, but I trust you'll make it memorable. Don't disappoint me.
say:20:1611104016:0.female: It truly is a shame I won't be present to witness the moment myself, but I trust you'll make it memorable. Don't disappoint me.

say:21:1611104017:0.text: Understood, Magister. I'll make good use of it.
say:21:1611104017:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷大人，我明白了，我会好好使用这份“礼物”。

say:22:1611104018:0.text: See that you do. And remember—your healed legs, your strength, your precious second chance... all of it came at a cost.
say:22:1611104018:0.source_cn: 记住，治愈双腿，给你强大的力量——这些都有条件，也有所限制。

say:23:1611104019:0.text: If the royal family learns you accepted the dark magic, that noble dream of yours will vanish like smoke in the wind. So...
say:23:1611104019:0.source_cn: 受到黑魔法恩惠这件事如果被王室知道，你一心想要得到的爵...

say:24:1611104020:0.text: ... Failure isn't an option, even against Merlin.
say:24:1611104020:0.source_cn: ……我只能成功，即便对手是梅林。
say:24:1611104020:0.male: ... Failure isn't an option, even against Merlin.
say:24:1611104020:0.female: ... Failure isn't an option, even against Merlin.

narration:26:1611104022:0.text: Cyran tears a rift in space, and Gervan steels himself and steps through.
narration:26:1611104022:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷将空间撕开裂隙，格墨文咬了咬牙，踏了进去
